from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/src/php-src/ext/standard/file.c')
s = p.read_text()
old_block = 'memcpy(tptr, hunk_begin, bptr - hunk_begin);\n\t\ttptr += (bptr - hunk_begin);'
new_block = 'size_t copy_len = (size_t)(bptr - hunk_begin);\n\t\tif (bptr < hunk_begin) {\n\t\t\tcopy_len = 0;\n\t\t}\n\t\tmemcpy(tptr, hunk_begin, copy_len);\n\t\ttptr += copy_len;'
if old_block in s:
    s = s.replace(old_block, new_block)
    p.write_text(s)
    print('Patched first occurrence')
else:
    # Try to patch with a more flexible approach by locating the snippet and replacing
    import re
    pattern = re.compile(r"memcpy\(tptr, hunk_begin, bptr - hunk_begin\);\n\t\ttptr \+= \(bptr - hunk_begin\);")
    if pattern.search(s):
        s2 = pattern.sub(new_block, s)
        p.write_text(s2)
        print('Patched via regex')
    else:
        print('Pattern not found; no patch applied')

# Also patch the second potential occurrence later in the function if present by a broader search

s2 = p2.read_text()
occ = 'memcpy(tptr, hunk_begin, bptr - hunk_begin);\n\t\ttptr += (bptr - hunk_begin);'

if count:
    s2 = s2.replace(occ, new_block)
    p2.write_text(s2)
    print('Patched second/any remaining occurrences')
else:
    print('No second occurrence found to patch')

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/src/php-src/ext/standard/file.c')
s = p.read_text()
import re
pattern = re.compile(r"(quit_loop_3:\s*\n)\s*memcpy\(tptr, hunk_begin, bptr - hunk_begin\);\n\s*tptr \+\= \(bptr - hunk_begin\);\n\s*bptr \+\= inc_len;\n\s*comp_end = tptr;", re.M)
match = pattern.search(s)
if not match:
    print('Pattern not found for patch region')
else:
    pre = match.group(1)
    # Build replacement block
    replacement = pre + (
        "\t\t\tsize_t _copy_len = (size_t)(bptr - hunk_begin);\n"
        "\t\t\tif ((ptrdiff_t)(bptr - hunk_begin) < 0) { _copy_len = 0; }\n"
        "\t\t\tmemcpy(tptr, hunk_begin, _copy_len);\n"
        "\t\t\ttptr += _copy_len;\n"
        "\t\t\tbptr += inc_len;\n"
        "\t\t\tcomp_end = tptr;"
    )
    s2 = s[:match.start()] + replacement + s[match.end():]
    p.write_text(s2)
    print('Patched patch region successfully')
